summary: Frontend-only test of the Patient Verifications 'Pending' tab auto-expand behavior for single-candidate pending verifications. Logged in as admin kevinrodriguez9528@gmail.com and verified: (1) auto-expand of MatchComparison on load for a verification with exactly ONE candidate; (2) toggle Hide collapses and the Compare toggle re-expands the widget; (3) no auto-approve/auto-link occurs — the patient remains in the pending queue after render. No pending multi-candidate verification data exists in preview DB, so multi-candidate UI path could not be exercised in-browser; code review in Verifications.jsx confirms auto-expand is strictly gated on `cands.length === 1` and multi-candidate rows still render independent per-candidate Compare toggles.
critical_code_review_comments: Verifications.jsx: `useEffect` depends on `items` (array reference changes each refetch) and uses an `autoLoaded` ref to dedupe single-candidate loads. If a user explicitly Hides an auto-expanded match and then the list is refetched (invalidate() after Verify/Reject on a different row), the ref prevents re-auto-expand of the already-dismissed row — this is the intended UX. However, since `autoLoaded` persists for the component's lifetime, if the SAME patient_id appears again after being rejected and resubmitted the auto-expand will not re-run until navigation away and back. Minor edge case, acceptable for v1.
Verifications.jsx: `loadCompare` always re-fetches on toggle Compare->Hide->Compare; could cache the last response per key to avoid duplicate GET /compare calls, but not critical.
No backend changes made (as required by UI-only change).
